summary: Candidate is a specialized variant of AgentOps initialization that adds environment variable loading and decorator-aware session configuration (auto_start_session=False). It should merge into the two existing broader AgentOps initialization skills, which cover basic client initialization and library setup. The candidate represents a more opinionated, production-ready pattern that refines the existing capabilities rather than introducing a distinct new capability. The peer candidates (070a969e and 928998f3) are the natural merge targets as they cover the same semantic domain (AgentOps client initialization) at the same granularity level. The third peer (7655f671) is orthogonal (thread-safe singleton pattern) and should not be merged.
